items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: The interviewer mentions Clark Terry as part of the trumpet section in a photo, but the interviewee (Dave Bennett) does not mention any personal interaction, meeting, or collaboration with Clark Terry, only with Doc Severinsen.

ctx.x: Yes. Skitch Henderson and Benny was the guest, and for some reason he requested Marian McPartland to play, and you’ve got the trumpet section in the back with Clark Terry and Snooky Young, Doc Severinsen, and Bob Rosengarden is the drummer and he’s the one that gave us this photo.

That is so cool. Hey you know I got a chance to play with Doc. I was twelve years old and it was in Greenwich Village. My mom’s uncle, she had some family that lived in White Plains. And I remember there was this documentary that came out on Benny on PBS American Masters. And Doc was one of the people they interviewed. And so my uncle said that Doc was playing in Greenwich. And so they said, “Let’s go out and see him.” So I would never in a million years do this now, but when you’re young you don’t know, you know…
